notes: Every studio run of boss-hero-assets, picked or rejected (design rule 5). The SDXL-CN jobs ran a byte-identical staged copy of art/workflows/sprites/boss-hero-sdxl-cn.json (sha256 cff8b70f…) from the main checkout ignored .build/ folder, because the studio reads workflows from the main checkout and the worktree branch is not merged. Inputs: frigate-clay-key.png = boss_sheet clayhint + keyin #00FF00 of the rig hero view; frigate-depth.png = the rig depth (hints drawn in); today-frigate-key.png = boss_sheet atlasframe frigate on #00FF00.

runs.prompt: Redraw image 1 as a finished, detailed painted game sprite of a monstrous demonic gargoyle warship seen from above and in front, with exactly the materials, colours and style of image 2: dark violet-grey carved stone armour plating with panel lines and rivets, ivory bone horns, tusks and fangs, two glowing ember-orange eyes, a dark fanged maw in the middle, two dark rectangular hangar bays, dark bat-wing membranes on bone fingers, a gothic stone tower with lit slit windows, small red and amber running lights. Keep the outline, every shape, the pose and the viewing angle of image 1 exactly. Solid flat green background (#00FF00), no checkerboard, no shadow.
